article_kitchen.summary: The kitchen is the busiest room in the house. After reading this, you can name the things you find in a kitchen, say what each one is for, and help safely while the family cooks.
article_kitchen.title: Things We Find in the Kitchen

article_specialization_blindspot.summary: A deep specialist reads a document from another field quickly and reads it wrongly, and the mistake is not stupidity. After reading this you can name what specialisation sharpens and what it hides, find the blind spot of your own field, run a six-step check on a decision that crosses two fields, and ask another field for its view without offending anybody.
article_specialization_blindspot.title: Specialisation and the Blind Spot: How the Best in One Field Misjudges Another
